welcome.title: Clarity for your chats
welcome.subtitle: Paste a conversation — see effort balance, then unlock deeper dynamics and reply options.

paste.title: Paste conversation
paste.placeholder:
Paste your chat here…
One message per line
paste.hint: Copy messages from Tinder, Bumble, Telegram, or any messenger

review.title: Review conversation
review.contextHint: Assign who is who — analysis uses observable patterns only
review.fewMessagesWarning: Few messages — insights may be less precise

insights.title: Chat clarity
insights.subtitle: Based on what appears in the messages — not on guessing feelings.
insights.disclaimer: This is a pattern summary from the text you pasted, not a verdict about anyone’s feelings.

bullets.youLead: You are carrying more of the conversational load in this snippet.
bullets.theyLead: They are carrying more of the conversational load in this snippet.
bullets.balanced: Message effort looks roughly shared in this snippet.
bullets.youInitiateMore: You pick up the thread more often after the other person.
bullets.theyInitiateMore: They pick up the thread more often after you.
bullets.youAskMore: You ask more questions than they do here.
bullets.theyAskMore: They ask more questions than you do here.

interest.title: Interest trend
interest.up: Their message engagement looks stronger toward the end of this chat.
interest.flat: Their engagement looks fairly steady across this chat.
interest.down: Their message engagement looks lighter toward the end of this chat.

ghost.title: Ghost risk (pattern)
ghost.low: Low — no strong cooling pattern in this snippet.
ghost.medium: Medium — some cooling or imbalance signals appear.
ghost.high: High — several cooling or unanswered-opener signals appear. Consider slowing down.

nextStep.title: Suggested next step
nextStep.coolDownDetail: Give space before another long message. One light check-in is enough.
nextStep.proposeMeetDetail: Engagement looks reciprocal enough to propose a low-pressure plan.
nextStep.waitDetail: You’ve already invested more — let them reopen the thread.
nextStep.clarifyDetail: Ask one clear question about plans or interest — without pressure.

locked.title: Full clarity is locked
locked.body: Effort Balance is free. Unlock deeper patterns and reply options.

compare.title: Since last analysis
compare.effortDelta: Your effort share changed by {{delta}} pts
compare.moreBalanced: Effort looks closer to balanced than last time.
compare.lessBalanced: Effort looks less balanced than last time.
compare.ghostChanged: Ghost-risk band changed versus last run.
compare.interestChanged: Interest trend changed versus last run.
compare.disclaimer: Comparison uses scores saved on this device only — not the chat text.

upload.title: Upload screenshot
upload.subtitle: On-device OCR is coming. You can pick a photo now; if recognition isn’t ready, paste the chat.
